北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京风大天冷，出门记得多穿点，注意防风保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is windy and cold, remember to dress warmly and protect against wind!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪风力较大，气温偏低，外出注意防风，别着凉了！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is windy and cold, take care against wind when out, don't catch a cold!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海天冷体感低，出门戴好围巾帽子，温暖出行哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai feels cold, wear a scarf and hat when out, stay warm!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州风力不小，早晚温差大，别忘了添衣防风哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is quite windy, with a large day-night temp difference, remember to layer up!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳天气宜人，早晚微凉，出行记得随身带件外套哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen's weather is pleasant, but slightly cool morning/evening, bring a light jacket!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州风力较大，体感寒冷，出门记得多穿衣物防风哦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is windy and feels cold, remember to layer up and protect against wind!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京天晴但体感寒冷，风力不小，多穿点才暖和哦！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is clear but feels very cold and quite windy, dress warmly to stay cozy!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都湿气重，阴冷感明显，出门记得做好防潮保暖哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is very humid and feels damp-cold, remember to guard against dampness and stay warm!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天微冷，湿度高，注意添衣保暖，别着凉了！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is overcast and a bit chilly with high humidity, remember to layer up!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴冷湿度大，体感温度低，注意防寒防湿保暖哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is damp-cold and very humid, with low perceived temp, stay warm and dry!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天湿度大，气温适中，注意保持室内通风干燥哦！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is overcast and humid, with moderate temps, keep indoor ventilation good!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨非常寒冷，记得全副武装，暖宝宝安排上哦！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is extremely cold, remember to bundle up thoroughly, and use hand warmers!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -20℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳寒风凛冽，气温很低，出门一定要穿暖和再走哦！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is bitterly cold with very low temps, make sure to dress very warmly before heading out!
沈阳.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -16℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明天气晴朗，风力不小，早晚温差大，记得添衣哦！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and quite windy, with a large day-night temp difference, remember to layer up!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门风力较大，体感微凉，出门要注意防风保暖哦！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is quite windy and feels a bit cool, take care to stay warm and guard against wind!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛风力强劲，体感极寒，务必全副武装，注意防风！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is very windy and feels extremely cold, make sure to bundle up completely and protect against wind!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连寒风刺骨，体感很低，多穿羽绒服和厚外套保暖哦！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian's wind bites, and it feels very cold, wear down jackets and thick coats to stay warm!
